pr_title: Fix duplicated path.Contains check and other checks in Path.GetFullPath

Fixes #54993

issue_context.title: Duplicated path.Contains('\0') check
issue_context.body:
<!--This is just a template - feel free to delete any and all of it and replace as appropriate.-->

### Description

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/57bfe474518ab5b7cfe6bf7424a79ce3af9d6657/src/libraries/System.Private.CoreLib/src/System/IO/Path.Windows.cs#L65

The method calls `public static string GetFullPath(string path)` where `path.Contains('\0')` is called again.

Discovered in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/54253

Perhaps there are other places where this expensive check is duplicated but I did not find after a quick search.

Hey everyone. I did a quick research and came up with a very straightforward solution like refactoring https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/57bfe474518ab5b7cfe6bf7424a79ce3af9d6657/src/libraries/System.Private.CoreLib/src/System/IO/Path.Windows.cs#L65 which is to replace using https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/57bfe474518ab5b7cfe6bf7424a79ce3af9d6657/src/libraries/System.Private.CoreLib/src/System/IO/Path.Windows.cs#L38
with some parts of the method.
Before doing that, I'd like to ask you if it is ok. I'm concerned because it would lead to too much of copypaste code. 

There is another option like to create a private method that would be based on **GetFullPath(string path)** and use it in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/57bfe474518ab5b7cfe6bf7424a79ce3af9d6657/src/libraries/System.Private.CoreLib/src/System/IO/Path.Windows.cs#L65 
@adamsitnik @Jozkee @jeffschwMSFT  What is your opinion on that?
@jeffhandley It seems there are a lot of places where the extra check presents.
@iSazonov Do you suggest that we reopen this issue for follow-up to find and eliminate the other occurrences? Did you already identify some other places that could be noted?
I am aware of some of the other locations of this check. I could submit a PR.
Great; thanks. I'll reopen this issue then. It would be helpful to capture the identified locations here and we can turn them into a task list in the issue description. Thank you both!
@jeffhandley could you assign this to me so I can track it in my todos? Thanks

review_comments:
Initial issue is about this line.
The simplest fix would be splitting  Path.GetFullPath() on public (contains input checks) and internal (contains rest of the code).
Ok. I'll switch the private to internal and make sure to remove any trailing whitespace on the two lines the checks pointed out. Thanks!

I'm sorry, I mean there's a lot of GetFullPath() usings in the libraries. Of course you can stop on the initial fix.
For example, see GetVersionInfo(), methods in class Directory/File and many, many others where we could use the internal GetFullQualifiedPath().
Notice, GetFullPath() has different implementations for Windows and Unix.
Ok. I'll submit a separate PR today, since these tests are almost done. If they approve the new refactoring, I'll apply it throughout the rest of the script.
